info.name: U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data Daily Treasury Statement API

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields (columns) to return. Omit to return all fields for the dataset. Example: `record_date,tot_pub_debt_out_amt`.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter rows using `field:operator:value`, comma-separated for multiple filters (AND). Operators are `lt`, `lte`, `gt`, `gte`, `eq`, and `in` (values in parentheses). Example: `record_date:gte:2020-01-01,security_desc:eq:Treasury Bills`.

params.name: sort
params.description: Comma-separated fields to sort by, ascending by default; prefix a field with `-` for descending. Example: `-record_date`.

params.name: page[number]
params.description: The page of results to return (1-based).

params.name: page[size]
params.description: Number of results per page. Maximum 10000.

items.docs: The Treasury General Account (TGA) operating cash balance reported each business day in the Daily Treasury Statement.
